article_context: 文章以马德里清洁空气区政策反复为例，批评欧洲依赖城市各自限行的碎片化治理：成本被转嫁给司机，而汽车制造商和国家政府应承担更大责任。

article.title: 阅读 Text 3 · 城市限行无法独自解决空气污染
article.background: 文章以马德里清洁空气区政策反复为例，批评欧洲依赖城市各自限行的碎片化治理：成本被转嫁给司机，而汽车制造商和国家政府应承担更大责任。

sentences.en: Madrid was hailed as a public health guiding light last November when it rolled out ambitious restrictions on the most polluting cars.
sentences.zh: 去年11月，马德里推出针对污染最严重车辆的雄心勃勃的限制措施，一度被誉为公共卫生治理的榜样。

segments.text: Madrid was hailed as a public health guiding light last November when it rolled out ambitious restrictions on the most polluting cars.

sentences.en: Seven months and one election day later, a new conservative city council suspended enforcement of the clean air zone, a first step toward its possible termination.
sentences.zh: 七个月并经历一次选举之后，新上台的保守派市议会暂停执行清洁空气区规定，这可能是最终取消该政策的第一步。

segments.text: Seven months and one election day later, a new conservative city council suspended enforcement of the clean air zone, a first step toward its possible termination.

sentences.en: Mayor Jose Luis Martinez-Almeida made opposition to the zone a centrepiece of his election campaign, despite its success in improving air quality.
sentences.zh: 尽管该区域已经成功改善空气质量，市长何塞·路易斯·马丁内斯-阿尔梅达仍把反对它作为竞选活动的核心议题。

segments.text: Mayor Jose Luis Martinez-Almeida made opposition to the zone a centrepiece of his election campaign, despite its success in improving air quality.

sentences.en: A judge has now overruled the city's decision to stop levying fines, ordering them restored.
sentences.zh: 如今，一名法官推翻了市政府停止罚款的决定，要求恢复处罚。

segments.text: A judge has now overruled the city's decision to stop levying fines, ordering them restored.

sentences.en: But with legal battles ahead, the zone's future looks uncertain at best.
sentences.zh: 但随着法律争端继续，其前景充其量只能说是不确定。

segments.text: But with legal battles ahead, the zone's future looks uncertain at best.

sentences.en: Madrid's back and forth on clean air is a pointed reminder of the limits to the patchwork, city-by-city approach that characterises efforts on air pollution across Europe, Britain very much included.
sentences.zh: 马德里在清洁空气政策上的反复，鲜明提醒我们：欧洲包括英国在内，以城市为单位、零散拼接式治理空气污染的方法存在明显局限。

segments.text: Madrid's back and forth on clean air is a pointed reminder of the limits to the patchwork, city-by-city approach that characterises efforts on air pollution across Europe, Britain very much included.

sentences.en: Among other weaknesses, the measures cities must employ when left to tackle dirty air on their own are politically controversial, and therefore vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 诸多弱点之一是，当城市被迫独自处理空气污染时，它们采用的措施往往具有政治争议，因此十分脆弱。

segments.text: Among other weaknesses, the measures cities must employ when left to tackle dirty air on their own are politically controversial, and therefore vulnerable.

sentences.en: That's because they inevitably put the costs of cleaning the air on to individual drivers—who must pay fees or buy better vehicles—rather than on to the car manufacturers whose cheating is the real cause of our toxic pollution.
sentences.zh: 这是因为，这些措施不可避免地把净化空气的成本压在个人司机身上——他们要缴费或购买更好的车辆——而不是让那些作弊、并真正造成有毒污染的汽车制造商承担成本。

segments.text: That's because they inevitably put the costs of cleaning the air on to individual drivers—who must pay fees or buy better vehicles—rather than on to the car manufacturers whose cheating is the real cause of our toxic pollution.

sentences.en: It's not hard to imagine a similar reversal happening in London.
sentences.zh: 不难想象，类似的政策逆转也可能发生在伦敦。

segments.text: It's not hard to imagine a similar reversal happening in London.

sentences.en: The new ultra-low emission zone (Ulez) is likely to be a big issue in next year's mayoral election.
sentences.zh: 新的超低排放区很可能成为明年市长选举中的重要议题。

segments.text: The new ultra-low emission zone (Ulez) is likely to be a big issue in next year's mayoral election.

sentences.en: And if Sadiq Khan wins and extends it to the North and South Circular roads in 2021 as he intends, it is sure to spark intense opposition from the far larger number of motorists who will then be affected.
sentences.zh: 如果萨迪克·汗获胜，并按计划在2021年把该区域扩展到北、南环路，那么届时受影响的大量司机势必会激烈反对。

segments.text: And if Sadiq Khan wins and extends it to the North and South Circular roads in 2021 as he intends, it is sure to spark intense opposition from the far larger number of motorists who will then be affected.

sentences.en: It's not that measures such as London's Ulez are useless.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说伦敦超低排放区之类的措施毫无用处。

segments.text: It's not that measures such as London's Ulez are useless.

sentences.en: Far from it.
sentences.zh: 恰恰相反。

segments.text: Far from it.

sentences.en: Local officials are using the levers that are available to them to safeguard residents' health in the face of a serious threat.
sentences.zh: 面对严重威胁，地方官员正在利用手中可用的政策工具保护居民健康。

segments.text: Local officials are using the levers that are available to them to safeguard residents' health in the face of a serious threat.

sentences.en: The zones do deliver some improvements to air quality, and the science tells us that means real health benefits.
sentences.zh: 这些区域确实能改善一定程度的空气质量，而科学告诉我们，这意味着真实的健康收益。

segments.text: The zones do deliver some improvements to air quality, and the science tells us that means real health benefits.

sentences.en: But mayors and councilors can only do so much about a problem that is far bigger than any one city or town.
sentences.zh: 但面对一个远超任何单一城市或城镇规模的问题，市长和议员能做的终究有限。

segments.text: But mayors and councilors can only do so much about a problem that is far bigger than any one city or town.

sentences.en: They are acting because national governments—Britain's and others across Europe—have failed to do so.
sentences.zh: 他们之所以采取行动，是因为英国以及欧洲其他国家的中央政府没有尽到责任。

segments.text: They are acting because national governments—Britain's and others across Europe—have failed to do so.

sentences.en: Restrictions that keep highly polluting cars out of certain areas—city centres, “school streets”, even individual roads—are a response to the absence of a larger effort to properly enforce existing regulations and require auto companies to bring their vehicles into compliance.
sentences.zh: 禁止高污染汽车进入市中心、“学校街道”乃至个别道路等限制措施，是在更大规模行动缺位时的应对办法；本应采取的行动，是切实执行现有规定，并要求汽车企业使车辆达到合规标准。

segments.text: Restrictions that keep highly polluting cars out of certain areas—city centres, “school streets”, even individual roads—are a response to the absence of a larger effort to properly enforce existing regulations and require auto companies to bring their vehicles into compliance.

sentences.en: Wales has introduced special low speed limits to minimise pollution.
sentences.zh: 威尔士已经实行特殊低速限速，以尽量减少污染。

segments.text: Wales has introduced special low speed limits to minimise pollution.

sentences.en: We're doing everything but insist that manufacturers clean up their cars.
sentences.zh: 我们几乎什么都做了，唯独没有坚持要求制造商把汽车变得更清洁。

segments.text: We're doing everything but insist that manufacturers clean up their cars.
